Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from bundler bump's shape changes, rest just deprecation noise:

- `src/core/options.js`: `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but new bundler hands `{ retryCount }`. Fixed field name.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` (new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`). Now treats `undefined` same as `false`.
